exposure: embolization of non-gonadal collateral supplying gestational sac (GS) in addition to uterine artery embolization (UAE)
outcome: time for serum β-human chorionic gonadotropin (β-hCG) levels normalization
finding: This study suggests that additional embolization of non-gonadal collateral supplying GS during UAE for CSP is feasible and safe, potentially reducing blood loss associated with hysteroscopic curettage.
